title: Workflow production source annotations (v1)
description: Evidence required for every file added to, removed from, or modified within the production source universe (bundled TS/JS or shipped asset) since the immutable pre-gate snapshot. Enforced by resolveProductionSourceUniverse.mjs, which also cross-checks evidence.liveSha256 / evidence.pregateSha256 against the digests it computes itself, so an annotation cannot silently go stale against the file it documents. Field set follows the plan's §1.5 annotation contract (path/span, symbol, source digest, edge kind, target action key, rationale, owner, expiry cohort), applied here to source files instead of routes.

disposition.description: "modified" covers a path present in both the pre-gate snapshot and the live scan whose content digest (sha256) differs — resolveProductionSourceUniverse.mjs computes and compares both digests itself at run time and additionally requires evidence.liveSha256 to match its own computation.

cohort.description: Matches the cohort names in plan §8's ownership-transfer table. "nonPlan" is reserved for ordinary product development (e.g. a model-catalog update) that touches a production-bundled file for reasons unrelated to this plan — it must still be recorded, but must not be laundered under a plan cohort it does not belong to.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this annotation staying true (plan §1.5's owner field).

expiryCohort.description: The plan §8 cohort at whose completion this annotation must be re-reviewed (and re-justified or retired) — plan §1.5's expiry-cohort field. "cleanup" for annotations that remain valid until the final legacy-removal cohort.

evidence.description: Machine-checkable evidence binding this annotation to exact file content. resolveProductionSourceUniverse.mjs fails closed when liveSha256 (added/modified) no longer matches the current file, when pregateSha256 (removed) does not match the immutable pre-gate snapshot, or when any of the four §1.5 descriptive fields (symbol, sourceSpan, edgeKind, targetActionKey) is absent or empty.

liveSha256.description: Required for added/modified: the sha256 of the file content this annotation's rationale was written against. Must be absent for "removed" rows — a removed path has no live content, resolveProductionSourceUniverse.mjs never reads this field for a removed row, and a value there would read as evidence without ever being checked.

pregateSha256.description: Required for removed (and optional for modified): the sha256 the path had in the immutable pre-gate snapshot.

symbol.description: Required §1.5 field: the primary symbol(s) the change concerns (e.g. an exported function name), or an explicit non-symbol descriptor for manifest/asset files (e.g. "scripts block").

sourceSpan.description: Required §1.5 field: human-readable span locator (e.g. "L1514-L1535", "L1-L226 (whole file)") for the change the rationale describes.

edgeKind.description: Required §1.5 field: the route/graph edge kind this file participates in (e.g. "command-handler", "runner-boundary", "shipped-prompt-asset", "build-manifest").

targetActionKey.description: Required §1.5 field: the registry action key this file's routes migrate to (e.g. "generatePlan.v1"), or an explicit "n/a (...)" / "multiple (...)" descriptor when the file is not owned by exactly one action row.
